items.prompt: A report assigns every row to exactly one accepted/rejected branch, but permits several reasons per rejected row. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Reason counts must always sum to the number of input rows
options.why: Accepted rows need not have rejection reasons.

options.text: Accepted plus rejected equals total; summed reason counts may exceed rejected
options.why: The row partition and reason labels are different counts.

options.text: Accepted can exceed total when one row has two reasons
options.why: Multiple reasons do not duplicate accepted input rows.

options.text: Reconciliation is unnecessary because reasons are present
options.why: A report can still omit or double-count rows.

items.explanation: Reconcile row counts independently of multi-label reason counts. State the reason policy so the report is interpretable.
